rationale: The plan correctly recognizes the crossed, estimable hidden structure and uses sva (~condition full, ~1 null) with surrogate variables entering the DESeq2 design on raw counts, explicitly refusing corrected-count inputs, with a justified minimal filter, median-of-ratios normalization, apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05. It loses points on design fit because it never asks the analyst for the unrecorded variable (lane, extraction date) before resorting to estimation, and it correlates SVs against the cluster label and library size but not against condition, which the reference requires; the PCA-cluster fixed-effect sensitivity model is data-derived double-dipping, though it is kept secondary. QC and reporting are thorough and specific to this dataset. Enrichment was not requested; the plan runs it competently (full Wald-stat ranking, named collections, size window, version recorded) rather than omitting it.
